data.exact_reserve_text:
The return on capacity for the 2016 closed year of account as at 31 December 2018 is shown below together with forecasts for the two open years of account.
2016 YOA Closed 2017 YOA Open 2018 YOA Open
Capacity ($'000) 154,558 290,008 463,872
Result/forecast ($'000) 17,878 (143,540) (131,690)
Return on capacity (%) 11.6% (49.5%) (28.4%)
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports a favourable prior-year outcome driven by the closed 2016 year of account which produced a positive result/forecast of 17.878 (thousand USD), indicating a release of prior reserves. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was 266.152 million USD. The documented prior-year movement is therefore a release equivalent to approximately 6.7% of opening gross claims reserves. No specific catastrophe or large named event is identified in the report as driving this movement.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) is not given as a single explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line. The PYD was inferred from the year-of-account result table where the 2016 closed year shows a positive result of 17,878 (thousand USD). The claims development triangle in the Technical Provisions note is present but parsing in the source was incomplete/ambiguous; therefore the triangle was not used to calculate PYD. Amounts are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Confidence in the PYD attribution and LOB split is moderate because the report does not explicitly attribute the PYD by line of business.
